title: Happy path
description: Clean text invoice with the PO printed. Every line matches PO-2038.

title: Split invoice exceeds PO
description: Third invoice on PO-2041: fine on its own, but cumulative billing reaches 108% of the PO.

title: Near-duplicate invoice
description: INV-1042A repeats the vendor and amount of the approved INV-1042, dated 6 days earlier.

title: Scanned, no PO number
description: Image-only scan, slightly rotated and noisy, with no PO number. The AI must infer the PO from the lines.

title: Bank details changed
description: Everything matches the PO, but the bank account on the invoice differs from the vendor master.

title: Within tolerance
description: A freight line puts the subtotal 1.3% over the PO, inside the 2% tolerance.
